text: CLI installer command to set up Sentry AI integration
quote: npx @sentry/ai install

text: MCP server connects AI assistants to search errors, analyze performance, triage issues, read docs, and manage projects
quote: Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects — all via the Model Context Protocol.

text: Alert rule sends Slack notification when a new issue is created
quote: Send a notification to your team's Slack channel when a **new** issue is created.

text: Dashboards give overview of application health across multiple projects' errors and performance
quote: Sentry's [Dashboards](https://sentry.io/orgredirect/organizations/:orgslug/dashboards/) provide you with a broad overview of your application’s health by allowing you to navigate through error and performance data across multiple projects.

text: Autofix automatically scans incoming issues, finds root causes, and automates triage
quote: Autofix: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage.

text: Seer AI reviews code changes in GitHub/GitLab to catch bugs before merge
quote: Have Seer review your code changes in GitHub or GitLab, catching bugs before merging.

text: Debug files management for iOS/Android, release and source maps, and code mappings for other platforms
quote: It’s primarily used for managing debug information files for iOS, Android, release and source maps management, as well as code mappings for other platforms.

text: Ingests OpenTelemetry traces and logs via OTLP endpoints from SDKs or collector
quote: Sentry can ingest OpenTelemetry traces and logs via OTLP endpoints, either directly from an OTel SDK

text: Explore span samples, visualize span attributes, and run flexible queries/aggregations over trace data
quote: You can now explore span samples, visualize span attributes, and aggregate your data with flexible queries and filters.

text: Filter issues by properties like browser, device, impacted users, or unhandled status
quote: This page allows you to filter by properties such as browser, device, impacted users, or whether an error is unhandled.

text: Can self-host the entire Sentry platform for free
quote: How you can run all of Sentry on your own server, without paying anything.

text: Simple SDK drop-in instrumentation with no separate agent installation required
quote: Drop in the [SDK](https://sentry.io/platforms/). No agents to install. No performance surprises.

text: Agent tracing catches unexpected AI output, bad tool calls, and visualizes agent spend/performance
quote: Agent tracing helps you catch unexpected output issues, bad tool calls and visualize the spend and performance across all your agents.

text: Web API lets you manage organizations, teams, and export/manage data programmatically
quote: You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.

text: Surfaces suspect commits, stack traces, and PR comments tied to issues
quote: Suspect commits, stack traces, and PR comments.

text: Cron/scheduled job monitoring set up in five lines of code
quote: Monitor in five lines

text: Official MCP server exposes a connected Sentry agent to external tools
quote: Sentry agent connected

text: One command teaches AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Grok) to install and configure Sentry
quote: One command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok how to install and configure Sentry for you.

text: Alerts trigger notifications, ticket creation, webhook calls, or other integrations based on rule matches
quote: Sentry's Alerts take action when issues in your organization match pre-defined rules. An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations

text: Offers a minimal, unsupported self-hosted setup that works out-of-the-box
quote: Sentry offers and maintains a minimal setup that works out-of-the-box for simple use cases. This version comes with no guarantees or dedicated support.

text: Solo/small-project plan includes error monitoring, tracing, alerts, dashboards, and MCP access
quote: For solo devs working on small projects... One user, Error Monitoring and Tracing, Alerts and notifications via email, 10 custom dashboards, MCP access

text: Supports SAML and SCIM for enterprise identity management
quote: SAML + SCIM support

text: Seer Agent answers natural-language questions about your application by finding relevant telemetry
quote: Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
